originals.why: 'os oedd hynna'n bosib' is a natural real-condition clause and uses bosib as 'possible'
'efallai fod o'n bosib' is idiomatic North Welsh, and bosib keeps its taught sense
Natural Welsh with a tag clause; 'glywes i' with mutation would be more usual, but the unmutated form is acceptable

originals.ko: 우리는 네 자매를 보기를 바랐어, 하지만 그건 가능하지 않았어
originals.why: Natural Welsh; 'doedd o ddim yn bosib' uses the same sense of possible

originals.ko: 그건 가능하지 않았어, 그래서 우리는 시간을 조금 더 갖고 싶었어
originals.why: Grammatical, natural Welsh; bosib keeps the same sense

originals.ko: 어쩌면 모든 것을 제때 끝내는 게 가능할지도 몰라
originals.why: Natural Welsh; 'o' is a dummy subject, so the Korean leaves out 그게 to avoid a double subject
